title: Very Disappointing Service - Difficult to cancel and unexpected charges
text:
I strongly advise others to be extremely cautious with Subpilot.

First, the service does not deliver what it promises. It claims to help users manage and cancel unwanted subscriptions, but in my experience, it fails to do so effectively.

One of the biggest problems is that if you subscribe through an Instagram advertisement or another external promotional link instead of directly through the Apple App Store, your subscription will not appear in your Apple subscription settings.

This makes cancellation extremely frustrating, especially when you want to cancel before the free trial ends. You simply cannot find where to manage or cancel the subscription.

Even within the mobile app, the cancellation process is unnecessarily complicated, confusing, and difficult to navigate.

In my case, I was charged an additional $39 that I never intended to pay. I tried to cancel the service, but the process was so difficult that I was unable to do so in time. I have also been unable to obtain a refund.

A service that claims to help people eliminate unwanted subscriptions should not make its own subscription so difficult to cancel.

Based on my personal experience, I cannot recommend Subpilot. I believe its subscription practices are misleading, and I strongly encourage others to think twice before signing up, especially through social media advertisements.
